paragraphs.text: Mirrankkar is a plane featured in the graphic novel Mezlok's Challenge .

Mirrankkar is a planet. Cities and villages of Mirrankkar all carry their own Shokal stone. Some inhabitants of the plane are powerful mages, and a competition is held in which each city or town chooses a duelist.
Mirrankkar was invaded by New Phyrexia 's Machine Legion in 4562 AR .
